# DOCX round-trip corpus

These five documents are synthetic fixtures generated by
`scripts/generate-docx-roundtrip-corpus.py`. They contain no user documents or
production translation content.

The corpus covers headings and hyperlinks, numbered and bulleted lists,
tables and nested tables, independent section headers and footers, Unicode,
page breaks, an image, and a document field. The generator normalizes ZIP
timestamps so rerunning it produces deterministic fixtures.

The Rust compatibility test rebuilds every fixture in translated and bilingual
mode, reopens all ten outputs through the production inspector, checks segment
order and structure, verifies untouched ZIP parts byte-for-byte, and confirms
that source bytes never change.
